resources.string: Trust Russian Ministry certificates for selected sites

Argon trusts Russian Ministry certificates for listed domains and their subdomains.
Trust is enabled for all sites in these zones. Domains outside them can be allowed individually.
To allow trust, enable a zone or add an individual domain.

Argon includes the Russian Ministry of Digital Development root certificate. These settings select the sites for which it is trusted. Certificates from other authorities follow the usual rules.

A domain entry includes its subdomains. IP addresses, wildcards such as *.example.com, and entire zones such as .com cannot be added.

Adding a domain does not bypass other certificate checks. Every domain name in the site certificate must be covered by an allowed rule.
